# DynamicSpikePruning

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A method that selectively drops less informative spikes during inference to reduce computational load without degrading task performance. Reduces energy consumption and latency in iNEST systems, making them viable for real-time, low-power gesture interfaces.
